name: Morisaki Nao
source:
Nao is enrolled in the fourth year program of Central Military Academy's preparatory division. She is a domestic woman who loves making snacks and enjoys hearing others compliment her cooking. She is a hard worker, reliable, and at times she can be cunning, while at other times her cute naivety stands out.
